title: The Portuguese Water Dog Swims With Webbed Paws
content:
A Portuguese Water Dog requires high-quality dog food suited to its age, size, and activity level. Feeding your dog a balanced diet supports its energetic nature and overall well-being.
While they don't shed as much as many other breeds, they do need regular coat care and frequent grooming sessions. Daily physical activity and training tips focused on mental challenges will also help keep this breed happy and healthy.
Owning a Portuguese Water Dog entails a commitment to consistent training, regular grooming, and active engagement. From Portuguese Water Dog puppies to full-grown adults, these medium-sized dogs are loyal, energetic, and full of life.
